sources.title: Australian National Accounts: National Income, Expenditure and Product
sources.coverage: Quarterly GDP and GDP per capita, seasonally adjusted chain volume. Latest published quarter is June 2026 (released 2 Sep 2026). September quarter is scheduled for 2 Dec 2026, 11:30 am AEDT.

sources.title: National Accounts key aggregates, release archive
sources.coverage: As-published GDP and GDP-per-capita growth from each quarter's key-aggregates workbook, used as real vintages.

sources.title: State final demand
sources.coverage: Quarterly chain-volume state final demand, seasonally adjusted, eight states and territories.

sources.title: Labour Force, Australia
sources.coverage: Monthly employment, unemployment rate and participation. October 2026 released 19 Nov 2026, 11:30 am AEDT. NT and ACT are the smoothed (trend) series because seasonally adjusted estimates are not in this dataflow.

sources.title: Labour Force by age
sources.coverage: Monthly youth (15–24) unemployment rate, seasonally adjusted.

sources.title: Consumer Price Index, Australia
sources.coverage: Monthly CPI index and annual change, weighted average of eight capital cities. September 2026 released 28 Oct 2026.

sources.title: Monthly Household Spending Indicator
sources.coverage: Monthly household spending, current prices, seasonally adjusted. September 2026 released 4 Nov 2026.

sources.title: Building Approvals, Australia
sources.coverage: Monthly original counts of new houses and other new dwellings. The September 2026 release page is dated 9 Nov 2026. Seasonally adjusted totals are quoted from that release; the SDMX dataflow used here exposes the original counts.

sources.title: Business Indicators, Australia
sources.coverage: Quarterly chain-volume sales growth by industry, seasonally adjusted, through June 2026.

sources.title: F1 and F1.1 Interest rates and yields – money market
sources.licence: Reserve Bank of Australia copyright. Statistical tables may be reproduced freely with attribution to the Reserve Bank of Australia.
sources.coverage: Daily cash-rate target (table published 20 Nov 2026) and the monthly cash-rate history in F1.1.

sources.title: F2 and F2.1 Capital market yields – government bonds
sources.licence: Reserve Bank of Australia copyright. Statistical tables may be reproduced freely with attribution to the Reserve Bank of Australia.
sources.coverage: Daily and monthly interpolated 2-year and 10-year Australian Government bond yields. Monthly history in the current file starts in 2013; daily yields through 18 Nov 2026.
